11947-on-the-edge-of-the-war-zone-from-t.title: to the Entrance of the Stars and Stripes
11947-on-the-edge-of-the-war-zone-from-t.creator: Mildred Aldrich
11947-on-the-edge-of-the-war-zone-from-t.description: A book by Mildred Aldrich. With the cannon booming out there no one feels in the humor, though now and then we do get shaken up a bit. Everything seems a long time ago. Yet it is really only nine days since the French troops advanced--nine days since Paris was saved.

24597-games-for-all-occasions.title: Games For All Occasions
24597-games-for-all-occasions.creator: Mary E. Blain
24597-games-for-all-occasions.description: A book by Mary E. Blain. This is a very simple game. Each player places a finger on the table, which he must raise whenever the conductor of the game says: "Birds fly," "Pigeons fly," or any other winged creatures "fly."

arxiv-2109-09526.title: IoT Vulnerability Data Crawling and Analysis Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement no. 786698. The work reflects only the authors’ view and the Agency is not responsible for any use that may be made of
arxiv-2109-09526.creator: Stavros Shiaeles 2 , Nicholas Kolokotronis 1 , Emanuele Bellini 3
arxiv-2109-09526.description: Abstract Internet of Things (IoT) is a whole new ecosystem comprised of heterogeneous connected devices —i.e. computers, laptops, smart-phones and tablets as well as embedded devices and sensors— that communicate to deliver capabilities making our living, cities, transport, energy, and many other areas more intelligent.

arxiv-2205-00283.title: Leveraging Emotion-specific Features to Improve Transformer Performance for Emotion Classification
arxiv-2205-00283.creator: Atharva Kshirsagar*, Shaily Desai*, Aditi Sidnerlikar, Nikhil Khodake, Manisha Marathe
arxiv-2205-00283.description: Abstract † † *Equal Contribution This paper describes team PVG’s AI Club’s approach to the Emotion Classification shared task held at WASSA 2022 2022 . This Track 2 2 sub-task focuses on building models which can predict a multi-class emotion label based on essays from news articles where a person, group or another entity is affected.

arxiv-2402-15011.title: A Conversational Brain-Artificial Intelligence Interface
arxiv-2402-15011.creator: Anja Meunier, Michal Robert Žák, Lucas Munz, Sofiya Garkot, Manuel Eder, Jiachen Xu, Moritz Grosse-Wentrup
arxiv-2402-15011.description: Abstract We introduce Brain-Artificial Intelligence Interfaces (BAIs) as a new class of Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs). Unlike conventional BCIs, which rely on intact cognitive capabilities, BAIs leverage the power of artificial intelligence to replace parts of the neuro-cognitive processing pipeline. BAIs allow users to accomplish complex tasks by providing high-level intentions, while a pre-trained AI agent determines low-level details.

arxiv-2406-17369.title: Charge transfer in T/H heterostructures of transition metal dichalcogenides
arxiv-2406-17369.creator: Irián Sánchez-Ramírez, Maia G. Vergniory, Fernando de Juan
arxiv-2406-17369.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Irián Sánchez-Ramírez, Maia G. Vergniory, Fernando de Juan. The 13 × 13 \sqrt{13}\times\sqrt{13} charge density wave state of the T polytype of MX 2 (M=Nb,Ta, X=S, Se) is known to host a half-filled flat band, which electronic correlations drive into a Mott insulating state. When T polytypes are coupled to strongly metallic H polytypes, such as in T/H bilayer heterostructures or the bulk 4H b polytype, charge transfer can destabilize the Mott state, but quantifying its magnitude has been a source of controversy.

arxiv-2412-00209.title: Digital Twin in Industries: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2412-00209.creator: Md Bokhtiar Al Zami, Shaba Shaon, Vu Khanh Quy, Dinh C. Nguyen
arxiv-2412-00209.description: Abstract Industrial networks are undergoing rapid transformation driven by the convergence of emerging technologies that are revolutionizing conventional workflows, enhancing operational efficiency, and fundamentally redefining the industrial landscape across diverse sectors. Amidst this revolution, Digital Twin (DT) emerges as a transformative innovation that seamlessly integrates real-world systems with their virtual counterparts, bridging the physical and digital realms.

arxiv-2502-11313.title: Tracking Adiabaticity in Non-Equilibrium Many-Body Systems: The Hard Case of the X-ray Photoemission in Metals
arxiv-2502-11313.creator: Gustavo Diniz¹, Felipe D. Picoli¹, Luiz N. Oliveira¹, Irene D’Amico²
arxiv-2502-11313.description: Abstract The level of adiabaticity determines many properties of time-dependent quantum systems. However, a reliable and easy-to-apply criterion to check and track it remains an open question, especially for complex many-body systems. Here we test techniques based on metrics which have been recently proposed to quantitatively characterize and track adiabaticity.

arxiv-2504-03468.title: D-Garment: Physically Grounded Latent Diffusion for Dynamic Garment Deformations
arxiv-2504-03468.creator: Antoine Dumoulin antoine.dumoulin@inria.fr, Adnane Boukhayma adnane.boukhayma@inria.fr, Laurence Boissieux laurence.boissieux@inria.fr, Bharath Bhushan Damodaran bharath.damodaran@interdigital.com, Pierre Hellier pierre.hellier@inria.fr, Stefanie Wuhrer stefanie.wuhrer@inria.fr
arxiv-2504-03468.description: Abstract We present a method to dynamically deform 3D garments, in the form of a 3D polygon mesh, based on body shape, motion, and physical cloth material properties. Considering physical cloth properties allows to learn a physically grounded model, with the advantage of being more accurate in terms of physically inspired metrics such as strain or curvature.

arxiv-2509-00846.title: Causal SHAP: Feature Attribution with Dependency Awareness through Causal Discovery
arxiv-2509-00846.creator: Woon Yee Ng 1 , Li Rong Wang 1 , Siyuan Liu 1 , and Xiuyi Fan 2 1
arxiv-2509-00846.description: Abstract Explaining machine learning (ML) predictions has become crucial as ML models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as healthcare. While SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) is widely used for model interpretability, it fails to differentiate between causality and correlation, often misattributing feature importance when features are highly correlated.

arxiv-2509-20927.title: SimDiff: Simulator - constrained Diffusion Model for Physically Plausible Motion Generation
arxiv-2509-20927.creator: Akihisa Watanabe Jiawei Ren Li Siyao Yichen Peng Erwin Wu Edgar Simo - Serra, [0.4em] Waseda University
arxiv-2509-20927.description: Abstract Generating physically plausible human motion is crucial for applications such as character animation and virtual reality. Existing approaches often incorporate a simulator-based motion projection layer to the diffusion process to enforce physical plausibility. However, such methods are computationally expensive due to the sequential nature of the simulator, which prevents parallelization.

arxiv-2601-01011.title: Intention Collapse: Intention-Level Metrics for Reasoning in Language Models
arxiv-2601-01011.creator: P. M. Vera
arxiv-2601-01011.description: Abstract Language generation maps a rich, high-dimensional internal state to a single token sequence. We study this many-to-one mapping through the lens of intention collapse : the projection from an internal intention space I I to an external language space L L .

europmc-pmc5405509.title: The burden, epidemiology, costs and treatment for Duchenne muscular dystrophy: an evidence review.
europmc-pmc5405509.creator: Ryder S, Leadley RM, Armstrong N, Westwood M, de Kock S, Butt T, Jain M, Kleijnen J.
europmc-pmc5405509.description: Background Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) is a rapidly progressive, lethal neuromuscular disorder, present from birth, which occurs almost exclusively in males. We have reviewed contemporary evidence of burden, epidemiology, illness costs and treatment patterns of DMD. This s

pmc-10480150.title: Functional evolutionary convergence of long noncoding RNAs involved in embryonic development
pmc-10480150.creator: Ane Olazagoitia-Garmendia, Rodrigo Senovilla-Ganzo, Fernando García-Moreno, Ainara Castellanos-Rubio
pmc-10480150.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Long noncoding RNAs have been identified in most vertebrates, but the functional characterization of these molecules is challenging, mainly due to the lack of linear sequence homology between species. In this work, we aimed to find functional evolutionary convergent lncRNAs involved in development by screening of k-mer content (nonlinear similarity) and secondary structure-based approaches combining in silico, in vitro and in vivo validation analysis.

pmc-10813208.title: Prefrontal network engagement by deep brain stimulation in limbic hubs
pmc-10813208.creator: Anusha Allawala, Kelly R. Bijanki, Denise Oswalt, Raissa K. Mathura, Joshua Adkinson, Victoria Pirtle, Ben Shofty, Meghan Robinson, Matthew T. Harrison, Sanjay J. Mathew, Wayne K. Goodman, Nader Pouratian, Sameer A. Sheth, David A. Borton
pmc-10813208.description: Prefrontal circuits in the human brain play an important role in cognitive and affective processing. Neuromodulation therapies delivered to certain key hubs within these circuits are being used with increasing frequency to treat a host of neuropsychiatric disorders. However, the detailed neurophysiological effects of stimulation to these hubs are largely unknown.

pmc-11436051.title: Cubature Kalman Hybrid Consensus Filter for Collaborative Localization of Unmanned Surface Vehicle Cluster with Random Measurement Delay
pmc-11436051.creator: Weicheng Liu, Jichao Yang, Tongbo Xu, Xiaolei Ma, Shengli Wang, Yongmin Zhong, Paolo Mercorelli
pmc-11436051.description: This paper addresses the collaborative localization problem for unmanned surface vehicle (USV) clusters with random measurement delays. We propose a Cubature Kalman Hybrid Consensus Filter (CKHCF) based on the cubature Kalman filter (CKF) for widely distributed USV clusters lacking global communication capabilities.

pmc-11488582.title: HNF4A-AS1 inhibits the progression of hepatocellular carcinoma by promoting the ubiquitin-modulated degradation of PCBP2 and suppressing the stability of ARG2 mRNA
pmc-11488582.creator: Wenbo Jia, Liang Yu, Bin Xu, Yanzhi Feng, Jinyi Wang, Deming Zhu, Chao Xu, Litao Liang, Yongping Zhou, Lianbao Kong, Wenzhou Ding
pmc-11488582.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a highly aggressive malignant tumor with a poor prognosis. Extensive research has revealed the significant role of long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) in the regulation of tumor development. In this study, high-throughput sequencing analysis was used to assess the expression levels of lncRNAs in three pairs of HCC tissues and their corresponding noncancerous tissues.

pmc-11821600.title: To start or not to start? An exploratory study of work meaningfulness among start-up co-founders
pmc-11821600.creator: Deniz Dirik, Burak Özdoğan
pmc-11821600.description: This study explores startup co-founders’ perceptions of meaningful work experiences in the dynamic and uncertain context of entrepreneurship. While entrepreneurial research has extensively examined firm-level outcomes such as performance and growth, the subjective experiences of entrepreneurs have remained relatively underexplored especially in an emerging country context.

pmc-12366621.title: HPV16 E6 and E7 expressing cancer cells suppress the antitumor immune response by upregulating KLF2-mediated IL-23 expression in macrophages
pmc-12366621.creator: Ruben Prins, Daniel J Fernandez, Omid Akbari, Diane M Da Silva, W Martin Kast
pmc-12366621.description: BackgroundHuman papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) positive cancers have a tumor environment that induces antigen-presenting cells to increase IL-23 expression. Unclear is if HPV16 E6/E7 oncoproteins expressed in these cancers play a role in upregulating interleukin (IL)-23 in the tumor microenvironment (TME), and how this cytokine impacts the antitumor cytotoxic T-cell response in HPV16+ cancer.

pmc-12528445.title: The impact of an integrated exercise and dietary counseling program on physiological biomarkers in sedentary bank employees: a randomized control trial
pmc-12528445.creator: Abrham Abebe, Alemmebrat Kiflu, Zeru Bekele
pmc-12528445.description: Sedentary behavior (SB) is a growing global health concern, particularly among bank employees, contributing to NCDs and increased mortality. While exercise and dietary modifications are recognized as effective interventions, their combined impact remains underexplored. This randomized controlled trial examined the impact of an integrated exercise and dietary counseling program on physiological biomarkers in sedentary bank employees.

pmc-12564470.title: Evaluating the Influence of CHI3L1 and PI3 Methylation in Allergic and Nonallergic Asthma
pmc-12564470.creator: Selene Baos, Lucía Cremades-Jimeno, María Ángeles de Pedro, María López-Ramos, Rubén Fernández-Santamaría, Cristina Rosales-Ariza, Joaquín Quiralte, Fernando Florido, Nicolás González-Mangado, María Jesús Rodríguez-Nieto, Germán Peces-Barba, Joaquín Sastre, Blanca Cárdaba, Toshimitsu Yamaoka
pmc-12564470.description: Previously, we defined CHI3L1 and PI3 as genes related with asthma and severity by analysis of differential gene expression. In this study, we investigated the role of DNA methylation in their regulation, and their relationship with protein levels and clinical parameters.

pmc-12993335.title: Evaluation of quality characteristics, antioxidant activity, functional groups of sweet potato by-products and their usage in sandwich bread processing
pmc-12993335.creator: Nguyen Chi Dung, Nguyen Minh Thuy, Tran Ngoc Giau, Hong Van Hao, Nguyen Van Thanh, Vo Quang Minh, Ngo Van Tai
pmc-12993335.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A substantial quantity of waste is generated during sweet potato processing, posing environmental and economic challenges. This study aimed to valorize sweet potato by-products (SPB) by drying and milling them into powder and incorporating the material into sandwich bread formulations as a partial replacement for wheat flour at levels of 10–25% (corresponding to formulas B1 to B4) along with control sample B0. The physicochemical, structural, and functional properties of SPB powder were evaluated to determine its suitability as a functional ingredient.

pmc-13091731.title: Patient profiles and disease characteristics of the IMSRN cohort: a multicentre study (2021–2025)
pmc-13091731.creator: Rohit Bhatia, Dheeraj Khurana, Madakasira Vasantha Padma Srivastava, Ajay Garg, Prachi Mohapatra, Manjunath Netravathi, Sruthi Nair, Biman Kanti Ray, Prabhakar Thirumal Appaswamy, Gagandeep Singh, Mugundhan Krishnan, Thomas Mathew, Lekha Pandit, Ravouf Asimi, Samhita Panda, Debashish Chowdhury, Tapa
pmc-13091731.description: SummaryBackgroundData of Central Nervous System (CNS) demyelinating disorders from India has been published from limited centres. The Indian Multiple Sclerosis And Allied Demyelinating Disorders Registry and Research Network (IMSRN) is a multicentric database for multiple sclerosis and allied demyelinating disorders in the Indian subcontinent.

pmc-13205541.title: Management of Facial Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Induced Vitiligo with Topical Ruxolitinib: Quantitative Assessment Using a Semi-Automatic Tool
pmc-13205541.creator: Thomas Breakell, Paolo Neri, Léonie A. N. Staats, Rafaela Kramer, Carola Berking, Michael Erdmann, Anke Hartmann
pmc-13205541.description: Simple SummaryImmunotherapy has greatly prolonged survival for patients with advanced melanoma but can cause multiple side effects, including vitiligo, a loss of skin pigmentation. Although the development of vitiligo is linked to better cancer outcomes, the visual patches can be distressing for patients and negatively affect quality of life. Treatment options are often unsatisfactory.

pmc-13312182.title: Role of vitamin D receptor and calcium sensing receptor in parathyroid cancer
pmc-13312182.creator: Dongxue Zhang, Teng Zhao, Dehui Bi, Jian Huang, Tao Jiang, Pengxiang Zhao, Bojun Wei

pmc-13523162.title: Electrocardiographic Predictors of Early Recurrence of Atrial Fibrillation After Electrical Cardioversion
pmc-13523162.creator: Keisuke Yonezu, Tetsuji Shinohara, Hirochika Yamasaki, Kei Hirota, Hidekazu Kondo, Akira Fukui, Hidefumi Akioka, Yasushi Teshima, Naohiko Takahashi
pmc-13523162.description: BackgroundAlthough electrical cardioversion (ECV) effectively restores sinus rhythm in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation (AF), early recurrence after successful ECV remains common in clinical practice. We investigated whether simple 12‐lead electrocardiographic markers and a composite ECG score could predict early AF recurrence.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 195 patients with persistent AF who underwent successful ECV.

pmc-13688964.title: Headache impact and quality of life following endometriosis surgery in women: a single-center observational study
pmc-13688964.creator: Filiz Değirmenci, Hamza Yildiz, Hakan Aytan, Mustafa Agah Teki̇ndal
pmc-13688964.description: BackgroundEndometriosis and migraine are common chronic conditions in women of reproductive age that impair quality of life and frequently co-occur as comorbid conditions. Evidence regarding the effects of treatments targeting one of these conditions on the course of the other remains limited.

uslaw-usc-t21-s379aa1.title: 21 U.S.C. § 379aa–1 — Serious adverse event reporting for dietary supplements
uslaw-usc-t21-s379aa1.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t21-s379aa1.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 9 (Federal Food, Drug, And Cosmetic Act); Subchapter VII (General Authority); Part H (Serious Adverse Event Reports). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Adverse event The term “adverse event” means any health-related event associated with the use of a dietary supplement that is adverse. (2) Serious adverse event.
